page.layout: One printed page, a title page with centred lines of type. Large capitals at the top, then smaller lines in the middle and a short imprint at the foot. A library stamp and stains lie over the lower half and are not transcribed.

main_text.l: D E. C Æ L O.

page.notes: The scan is very faded and blotted. Only the largest heading, "DE CÆLO", and perhaps "LIBRI TRES", can be made out with any confidence; the smaller lines, including the imprint at the foot, are illegible. The readings marked [?] are guesses. A round library stamp and ink blots cover parts of the page and are not transcribed.
